host_id.description:
IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) to query.
          Example: "1.1.1.1" or "2001:4860:4860::8888"

at_time.description:
ISO 8601 timestamp to query historical data.
                  Example: "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
                  If None, returns current/latest data.

host_id.description:
IP address to query timeline for.
          Example: "192.168.1.1"

start_time.description:
ISO 8601 A timestamp for timeline query.
              Example: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"

end_time.description:
ISO 8601 Another timestamp for timeline query.
            Example: "2024-12-31T23:59:59Z"

query.description:
Censys search query using proper Censys query language syntax.

        **VALID EXAMPLES:**
        - `host.services.protocol: SSH` (SSH servers)
        - `host.services.port: 22` (services running on port 22)
        - `host.location.country: "United States" AND host.services.port: 443` (US HTTPS)
        - `host.services.software.product: nginx` (nginx servers)
        - `host.services.cert.parsed.subject.common_name: example.com` (certificates)
        - `cert.names: "example.com"` (certificates whose subject or SANs match a domain)

        **INVALID EXAMPLES:**
        - `port=22` (wrong syntax, use `host.services.port: 22`)
        - `country=US` (wrong syntax, use `host.location.country: "US"`)
        - `ssl_cert=example.com` (wrong field, use correct certificate field)
        - `cert.parsed.names: "example.com"` (not queryable — use `cert.names: "example.com"`)

fields.description:
Specific fields to return to reduce response size.
               Example: ["host.ip", "host.services.port", "host.location.country"]
               **TIP**: Specify fields to prevent context window overflow!
               If None, returns default fields.

page_size.description:
Number of results per page (1-1000).
            Default: 50. If None, uses the default.

page_token.description:
Token for pagination. Use next_page_token from previous response.
                     If None, starts from first page.

certificate_id.description:
Certificate SHA-256 fingerprint in hex format.
                 Example: "4954bd2f8791c4b645bfe451323dbea1986af39c5d35aa030811aa07f34edf3b"
